responsibility: Declares the builtin inventory for CORE-V vendor extensions in table form for consumption by the RISC-V builtin framework. It maps exported builtin names to internal builtin identifiers, prototype signatures, expansion style, and extension groups for XCVMAC, XCVALU, XCVELW, XCVSIMD, and related operations, serving as the declarative interface layer between user-visible intrinsics and the RTL patterns in corev.md.
same_name_distinction: Unlike corev.md, this is the declarative builtin registry for CORE-V extensions: it lists RISCV_BUILTIN entries, user-visible names, type signatures, and extension tags that map intrinsics onto backend support, rather than defining the instruction RTL patterns themselves.
